text:
A relaxed session on quiet areas, minutes
Our senior planner welcomed everyone

Attendees were Naomi Chaudhary, Caleb Mendes, and Pip.

The team reviewed routine desk work for Aurelia Skyways and focused on keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm, clear, and easy to use for travelers. The passenger coordinator walked through the usual travel steps, reminding the group to check carrier fit, document readiness, and cabin expectations early so customers can avoid last-minute stress. The safety coordinator spoke about hazards and prevention, with emphasis on steady handling, quiet waiting areas, and simple checks that help pets move through the journey comfortably.

The team also discussed how to answer common questions in a friendly way and keep messages consistent across phone, email, and counter conversations. Naomi Chaudhary and Caleb Mendes were used as helpful examples of travelers who benefit from clear guidance, while Pip was mentioned as a reminder that calm handling supports a smoother trip. The group agreed to keep sharing short updates and to flag any unusual concerns right away.

The meeting ended on a positive note and closed with agreement to continue the same approach.
